description: Run your Booqable rental business: create orders and book products on them, reserve, archive or cancel orders, manage customers and product groups, check availability, and list invoices and payments. Start workflows on new orders, status changes and new customers.

booqable_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs for each new customer in Booqable, whether added by staff or at checkout in the online store, with their name and email. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.created_at: When they were added, in UTC.
output.id: The customer's ID, for Get customer.
output.name: The person's or company's name.

booqable_new_order_trigger.description: Runs for each new order in Booqable once it is saved (as a draft, reserved or later), with its rental period, customer and totals. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.created_at: When it was created, in UTC.
